$comment: S21 · PR 414 (Blueprint B7.3) — the saved browser journeys, replayed by tools/journeys.mjs on the owner's schedule (Reports › Site health; infra/deploy/journeys.sh) on a phone and a desktop screen. Plain Playwright, AI not needed. Each journey is a list of steps: `open` a path (signed out for the customer, as the read-only check account for the others) and `expect` a selector there; `follow` the first link matching a selector (the products and categories are the owner's, so none is named here; with `optional`, a shop with none skips the rest of that journey and says so); `click` the first enabled element matching a selector; `api` sends a request from the page and expects a status (the permission limits: each write here is harmless even if it were allowed, an invalid body, and must be refused with 403). The staff journeys sign in as the read-only check account (like the smoke test), so they walk what each role opens and prove a write is refused; a role's own account per journey is a follow-up. A step fails on a 5xx, the error screen, a console error, a page error, a failed request, or a missing `expect`. The customer journey never adds to the bag (that would hold real stock) and never places an order (a real order on the live shop); the order, invoice and tracking pages are opened with no order (their 'not found' cards). `expectAny`: any one of the selectors.
